reason: A VS Code-style workspace file explorer providing sidebar navigation, file operations, search, split multi-tab previews, and support for common code, document, media, archive, and data formats.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类似 VS Code 的工作区文件资源管理器，支持文件树浏览、搜索排序、文件操作以及多标签分屏预览。
summaries.en: A VS Code-style workspace file explorer for DeepSeek Harness with file tree navigation, search and sorting, file operations, and multi-tab split previews.

capabilities: creates, renames, and deletes files or folders
opens files with previews for code, documents, images, audio, video, archives, and tabular data
converts PPT/PPTX files to PDF for preview
displays account balance and update notifications
